meta.title: Twenty percent is double, then one place left

success.message:
Session complete. 20% = ×2, then one place left (÷10).

SAMPLE: 20% of $42.30=$8.46, 20% of 80=16.

start.message:
SAMPLE: 20% tip on $42.30.

What is the 20% motion?

choices.label: Double the bill, then move one place left
Take 10% twice in your head, but skip the double-shift name
Round the tip to $20 because the bill is about 40

wrong_start_ten_twice.message:
10% twice is the same number. This family trains ×2, then one place left.

Return to the motion.

wrong_start_twenty_bucks.message:
$20 would be ~50%. 20% of ~40 is about $8.

Return to the motion.

wrong_apply_84.message:
Doubling without ÷10 is 200%. One place left on 84.60 is 8.46.

Revisit the shift.

wrong_apply_4_23.message:
4.23 is one place left on 42.30 (10%). 20% is twice that.

Revisit the shift.

check.message:
20% of 80, same motion.

What is it?

choices.label: 160 — doubled and kept the extra zero

wrong_check_8.message:
8 is 10% of 80. Double that for 20% → 16.

Try the check again.

wrong_check_160.message:
160 would be 200%. ×2 then one place: 160 → 16.

Try the check again.
